title: Will She’s The Best by Troye Sivan have above 30000 Album Equivalent Units during the October 09, 2026 - October 15, 2026 tracking week? Above 30K
rules: If She’s The Best by Troye Sivan has above 30K Album Equivalent Units during the October 09, 2026 - October 15, 2026, tracking week, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
IMPORTANT INFORMATION: This event pertains to the U.S. and will resolve based on the value reported by Luminate’s API as of 10:00 AM ET on the Sunday immediately following the October 09, 2026 - October 15, 2026 tracking week.

Luminate Data, LLC is a neutral provider of market metrics which does not endorse, verify or participate in any way in the outcomes of any prediction market.

blind.reasoning: She's the Best came out Oct 9, 2026, so the Oct 9–15 window is its whole debut week. Sivan's last two albums reportedly debuted in the Billboard 200 top 5 (Bloom with about 38K units, from memory), and his profile has grown since. A total of roughly 18–25K from record sales plus 10–15K from streaming puts it near or slightly above 30K. His modest US streaming and a fast rollout that wasn't built around first-week sales keep this close to a coin flip.
blind.falsifier: Billboard or Hits Daily Double first-week reporting showing the album debuting with fewer than 30,000 US units (e.g., ~22-28K and a debut outside the top 10).

final.reasoning: The market at 0.48 likely reflects information I couldn't check, such as first-week projections, so I moved my estimate from 0.58 to 0.53. That leaves only a few points above the 0.50 ask, which is too thin an edge for estimates resting partly on unverified memory of prior debuts.
